title: Preparing for the Wave with the Slaves
text: Time passed in that sort of fashion, and eventually it came down to selecting the members for tackling Melromarc’s Wave.

“It’d be a hassle if people got the idea we’ve got too many people under us, so… this time let’s handle Melromarc with a small elite squad. Raphtalia-chan and the others, along with those cooperating with us, can go participate in Siltvelt’s Wave instead, which should pose no problem.”
“Understood.”
We gathered everyone at Panda’s village for a strategy meeting, I say. Incidentally, Big Sister and the others had partially relocated here from Zeltoble as well.
“Naofumi-sama, may we participate?”
“For Melromarc, I think it’s best if Rifana-chan and Raphtalia-chan and the others stay behind and hold down the fort. I understand you want to protect people, but…”
Big Sister’s friend looked up at Father alongside Big Sister, pleading their case.
“Even when you’re just trying to help people, having soldiers or whoever attack you and call it ‘friendly fire’ really wears on you mentally.”
“But…”
Father smiled gently at Big Sister and the others, whose faces still showed they wanted to participate no matter what.
“I’m not saying this to be mean, you know? It’s just that if you two went somewhere dangerous, I’d feel terrible facing Sadeena-san about it.”
“That’s right~ If you absolutely must go out, go help people struggling with Waves happening elsewhere~ The Heroes fight Waves in all sorts of places, so let’s be patient, okay~”
Older Sister agreed with Father’s reasoning and soothed them as well.
“You have to let me participate for sure next time!”
“Absolutely!”
“Yes.”
“Well… if we’re careful about it, I suppose it wouldn’t be impossible.”
Panda’s grandfather and grandmother were present as well, indeed. Manpower shouldn’t be an issue.
“So, what about us?”
Panda’s grandfather asked whether they’d be able to go too.
“Even though you’re skilled, you’re still recovering from illness, and your stamina isn’t at its peak, is it? I’d like you to participate starting from the next Wave.”
“I see.”
“If the Hero says so, then reluctant as it is, let’s grit our teeth and hold back this time.”

Panda’s grandfather and grandmother had a gap in their abilities due to age, so it seemed they’d be sitting this one out. Indeed, the sharpness of their techniques clearly wasn’t what it used to be, from what I recalled.
“In that case, who is the Hero planning to select?”
The Siltvelt envoy asked Father.
“Well, myself and Motoyasu-kun are locks. As for me, I think Shion and Theo, who are known domestically as my slaves, would be the safe choices to bring along.”

Since Big Sister and the others were staying behind, that presumably meant Older Sister wasn’t participating either. The mixed-breed Lizardman and the Rabbit Man nodded, indeed. That meant they’d agreed to take on the Wave.
“…Will do.”
“I’ll give it my best. I’m plenty motivated. It feels like I’ve become a character in a story.”
The Rabbit Man seemed to be quite the story lover, I say.
“Vof!?”
Wolf let out a voice as if he couldn’t believe his name hadn’t been called.
“Vau vau!”
Me! I want to go too, even though I don’t know what I’ll be doing! —or so Wolf seemed to be saying with his voice.
“Waoo~n!”
I wanna go—! He hopped up and down, wagging his tail, indeed.
“Wolf-nii-chan’s really making his case, huh, big bro. I wanna go too—waoo~n.”
Keel chimed in with her own self-assertion right beside Wolf. Truly, a pack of dogs, I say.
“Keel-kun aside… hmm… well, Wolf’s level is high, but he’s classified as an unrecoverable combat slave, so maybe they’ll overlook it?”
Incidentally, like the Rabbit Man, Wolf’s old wounds apparently had been healing in a good direction too, thanks to Father’s various care.
“Still, I can’t bring him to official places—like the castle or the church.”
“That’s true.”
“Ehh! I wanna go too!”
“Luna wants to go with Keel-kun too—”
“…Buu.”
And there was Lazy Pig, lying down on the corner sofa as if it were the most natural thing in the world. Why on earth were you here? Did Father bring you along since this was a strategy meeting?
“Is Elena-nee-chan going?”
“Elena-san’s parents ordered her to accompany the Heroes, so it’s already decided~”
“Then it’s fine since Elena-nee-chan brought me along, right?”
“Ah! Keel-kun, that’s not fair!”
“Not fair!”
Keel was met with protests from Big Sister and the others.
“Hmm…”

Father wore an extremely troubled expression, I say. Back when he stayed in Melromarc, Father would’ve had Keel participate without hesitation, but things were different now. It must’ve been a real dilemma. If he brought Keel along, he’d practically have to let Big Sister and the others participate too. Because of Older Sister’s watchful eyes, Big Sister and the others were being kept away from danger even though they wanted to go.
“Ara, Keel-chan. Gaelion understands how you feel, but let’s stay behind this time, okay? Try not to trouble Naofumi-chan and the others too much.”
“Chee…”
With Older Sister’s warning, Keel backed down. For a Wave occurring in Siltvelt, she could participate without issue, indeed. In Melromarc, though, they might slap some strange accusation on her.
“Hey, what about Kou—?”
“Can Yuki go too?”
“Yuki-chan and the others are free to go, indeed!”
After all, they were my Filolial-samas, I say!
“Yay. Everyone, Kou and the others will work hard enough for everyone’s share, so wait for us—”
“Kou’s itching for a fight.”

Kou declared to Big Sister and the others that they could leave the rest to him. Oh ho, so Kou was even taking on the role of soothing Big Sister and the others as a dependable big brother, I say. Truly the fruit of Elephant and Big Sister and the others’ upbringing.
“What should I do, then?”
Here, Elephant also asked if he could participate.
“Elmelo-san going might be risky too… I’d rather not provoke Melromarc too much.”
“I see… will that be all right?”

“Well… according to Motoyasu-kun, given the location, maybe it’d be fine if you waited at the Slave Trader’s circus tent, and then came over slowly once the Wave broke out nearby, treated as a slave dispatched because of the emergency. That way, Keel-kun and the others can come too.”
“Oh! Seriously!? Yay!”
“Well, I’ll have it wrapped up before everyone arrives, though.”
“Ehh~”
Father smiled and placed a finger to his lips as he spoke, I say. That gesture… so even Gentle Father does that. …It struck me anew, that resemblance.
“Keel-kun.”
Luna-chan raised her hand at this point.
“What is it, Luna-chan?”
“If you want to go that badly, Luna will wrap Keel-kun up and rush over quickly.”
“All right! I’ll go later together with Elmelo-nee-chan! Wolf-nii-chan, do your best—!”
Keel, who’d been so eager to participate, flipped like a switch and declared her intent to go with Elephant instead, indeed.
“Buu…”

Luna-chan looked dissatisfied, I say. And so, the ones set to participate in Melromarc’s Wave ended up being Father, myself, the mixed-breed Lizardman and Rabbit Man, Wolf, Lazy Pig, and some of the Filolial-samas headed by Yuki-chan and the others, indeed. Now then, once we clear this Wave, we’d be just one step away from the Filo-tan experiment, indeed.

With that settled, it was time to select the equipment we’d use for Melromarc in preparation for the Wave. The gear nominally supplied at the Monster Dealer’s would’ve sufficed, but in the spirit of splurging a little more, we headed to Melromarc’s weapon shop, indeed. In the lineup prepared for the Wave, Lazy Pig stayed behind to hold the fort. As for the Filolial-samas, Yuki-chan and Kuro-chan accompanied us this time, indeed.
“Oh? You lot, been a while, eh.”
The weapon shop owner greeted us cheerfully upon seeing us.
